subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

In the Director’s party,/ everyone noticed/ that he sings more too faster.

options.text: that he sings more too faster

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"more too faster"** is grammatically incorrect because it contains a redundancy.
 
• The word **"faster"** is already a comparative form of "fast" and does not require "more" or "too" before it simultaneously.
 
• You can say either **"too fast"** or **"much faster"**, but **"more too faster"** is incorrect.
 
• The corrected sentence should read: **"that he sings too fast"** or **"that he sings much faster."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"In the Director’s party, everyone noticed that he sings **too fast**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "everyone noticed"** – grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 2: "In the Director’s party,"** – grammatically correct prepositional phrase.
 
• **Option 3: "No error"** – incorrect, as Option 4 clearly contains an error.
